author: Kai Moreno
title: QBR prep checklist for CSMs
content:
# Purpose
Internal checklist before a quarterly business review. Customers should not see this page used as policy on a SUP ticket.

# When to use
Internal checklist before a quarterly business review. Customers should not see this page used as policy on a SUP ticket.

# What Support does
If a customer asks for a QBR, assign Customer Success, P4. Do not change priority, labels, or keys. Support does not run the QBR.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
If a customer asks for a QBR, assign Customer Success, P4. Do not change priority, labels, or keys. Support does not run the QBR. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
